name: CTI Pivot
description: Infrastructure attribution for CTI: cluster nodes by shared registrar / nameserver / ASN / TLS certificate and link them, revealing which entities likely belong to the same operator. Pure graph analysis — no network, no keys.

plugins.name: Shared-Attribute Pivot
plugins.description: Clusters the selected (or whole-graph) infrastructure by discriminating shared observables — registrar, nameserver, announcing ASN, TLS certificate — and links each cluster with a "shared X" edge. The CTI attribution analogue of identity resolution. No network.
